name: Azeroth Companion
title: Talent Atlas — Interactive Canvas & Visual Performance
features: Touch and mouse drag-to-pan on the talent tree, including direct drag on node cards outside their interactive controls.
Interactive zoom from 25% to 140%, Fit and Reset options, and a tappable mini-map.
Refreshed visual tree with clearer allocation states, readable source connections, and mobile-friendly controls.
Navigation additions do not write to planned rank, choice, or saved-build data; v5.2 Blizzard source intelligence is retained.
All visuals are decorative; no unsupported official skill icon, game-valid loadout, combat simulation, or theoretical item results are claimed.
